title: Sealed Dungeon card icon (mockup)
caption: The pickaxe becomes the game's Sealed Dungeon map marker on a dark tile, and each Kibelisk mention gets the Kibelisk marker.

title: Stronghold card icon (mockup)
caption: The castle becomes the game's Stronghold campfire marker, on the same dark tile as the story and dungeon cards.

title: Dungeons card markers (mockup)
caption: The Strongholds and Sealed Dungeons headings carry their map marker, and each region's trace count shows the feather in place of the word.
